<?php
// Read first line: x1 y1 x2 y2
$line1 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line1));

// Read second line: x y
$line2 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x, $y) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line2));

// Differences
$dx = $x2 - $x1;
$dy = $y2 - $y1;

// Check parity
if ((($dx + $dy) & 1) != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

// Compute a and b
$a = ($dx + $dy) / 2;
$b = ($dx - $dy) / 2;

// Check divisibility and non-negativity
if ($a % $x != 0 || $b % $x != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$k1 = intdiv($a, $x);
$k2 = intdiv($b, $x);

if ($k1 < 0 || $k2 < 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

// Now check y-direction consistency
// From equations:
// k3 = k1 - dy / y
// k4 = k2 + dy / y
if ($dy % $y != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$dyDivY = intdiv($dy, $y);
$k3 = $k1 - $dyDivY;
$k4 = $k2 + $dyDivY;

if ($k3 < 0 || $k4 < 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

echo "YES\n";
?>

<?php
// Read first line: x1 y1 x2 y2
$line1 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line1));

// Read second line: x y
$line2 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x, $y) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line2));

// Differences
$dx = $x2 - $x1;
$dy = $y2 - $y1;

// Check parity
if ((($dx + $dy) & 1) != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

// Solve for a and b:
// a + b = (dx + dy) / 2
// a - b = (dx - dy) / 2
$sum = ($dx + $dy) / 2;
$diff = ($dx - $dy) / 2;

// sum = a*x, diff = b*y
// a = sum / x, b = diff / y
if ($sum % $x != 0 || $diff % $y != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$a = intdiv($sum, $x);
$b = intdiv($diff, $y);

// a and b must be integers (already ensured) and non-negative
if ($a < 0 || $b < 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

echo "YES\n";
?>

<?php
// Read first line: x1 y1 x2 y2
$line1 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line1));

// Read second line: x y
$line2 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x, $y) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line2));

// Differences
$dx = $x2 - $x1;
$dy = $y2 - $y1;

// Check parity: dx and dy must both be even or both be odd
if ((($dx & 1) != ($dy & 1))) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

// Solve for a and b in:
// a + b = dx / x
// a - b = dy / y
// => a = (dx/x + dy/y)/2, b = (dx/x - dy/y)/2
// We need dx divisible by x and dy divisible by y
if ($x == 0 || $y == 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

if ($dx % $x != 0 || $dy % $y != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$u = intdiv($dx, $x);
$v = intdiv($dy, $y);

// Now a = (u + v)/2, b = (u - v)/2 must be integers and >= 0
if ((($u + $v) & 1) != 0 || (($u - $v) & 1) != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$a = ($u + $v) / 2;
$b = ($u - $v) / 2;

if ($a >= 0 && $b >= 0) {
    echo "YES\n";
} else {
    echo "NO\n";
}
?>

<?php
// Read first line: x1 y1 x2 y2
$line1 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
if ($line1 === '') exit;
list($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line1));

// Read second line: x y
$line2 = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($x, $y) = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line2));

// Differences
$dx = $x2 - $x1;
$dy = $y2 - $y1;

// If dx or dy not divisible by x or y respectively, impossible
if ($dx % $x != 0 || $dy % $y != 0) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

$nx = intdiv($dx, $x);
$ny = intdiv($dy, $y);

// Parity condition: nx and ny must have same parity
if ( ($nx % 2) != ($ny % 2) ) {
    echo "NO\n";
    exit;
}

echo "YES\n";
?>
